images.filename: Sleeping in the shadow of Robert E. Lee.jpg
images.caption: This is a picture of a homeless man sleeping in the Charlottesville park, where the  August 12th riot started, and ended in the death of Heather Heyer.  This picture was taken 5/21/17, just 1week after the first alt-right protest on May 13th.  The homeless congregate in the park, when it isn’t raining.  They are usually on the other side of the statue and are quite loud, which is probably why this man chose to sleep on the opposite side of the statue.
images.alt: This is a picture of a homeless man sleeping in the Charlottesville park, where the  August 12th riot started, and ended in the death of Heather Heyer.
